plan: With a private value of $30, I want to maximize potential profit. In Stage 2's descending clock auction, I'll aim to claim the item just above my value. Since my value is $30, I want to bid strategically to win at a price close to but slightly below $30. A bid around $29.9 would allow me to claim the item and still generate a small profit if I win. This accounts for potential competitor strategies while protecting my potential earnings.

In a single-round sealed bid auction with a descending clock, the optimal strategy is to bid strategically based on my private value. With a value of $7, I want to win only if the price drops to near my value. I'll bid slightly above my value to increase my chances of winning at a low price, but not so high that I risk negative profit. A bid around $7.50 seems reasonable - it gives me a chance to claim the item near my true value.

In a single-round sealed bid auction with a descending clock, the optimal strategy is to bid slightly below my true value. Since my value is $36, I want to claim the item near that price. A bid around $35.50 would position me to win when the clock reaches my bid, capturing most of the item's value. This strategy balances winning probability with profit maximization, accounting for potential competitive bidding from other players.
